name: MCP Chain of Draft
situation: Every AI integration was re-implementing its own glue between agents, tools and context.
obstacle: Adoption depended on other engineers actually picking it up, and documentation alone does not move people.
decision: Open-sourced a Model Context Protocol server giving agents one scoped interface, and drove it through live-coded tutorials and internal deep-dives.
result: My most-starred repository, adopted by 30+ engineers.
